positions.title: Software Developer
positions.insights: Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Database Management System (DBMS) and +2 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created a case life cycle for an employee reimbursement management system to handle the business transaction process.
• Used Jira board for Scrum/Agile Methodologies to manage development as a team.
• Configured child cases and optional actions to help the employee update or add additional documents as needed.
• Constructed an Authority Matrix structure to automate the decision process in obtaining the different levels of approvals.
• Created section rules with a dynamic layout for a responsive User Interface to fit the different screen sizes.

positions.title: Application Developer Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked on prototyping survey feature for HughesNet Mobile Android App (front and back end) 
•	Created a target survey for a specific subset of HughesNet customers
•	Provided rewards (usage bytes/tokens) to users who completed the survey by invoking API calls
•	Worked on admin dashboard to configure and manage surveys with the support of Django framework and MongoDB database
•	Utilized Google Cloud Firebase platform to target and send push notification to inform customers when new a survey is available

positions.title: Student Tutor
positions.description:
•	Tutored students who take C++, Java, system analysis, and other computer science classes
•	Helped students with their academic and personal projects
•	Monitored computer lab and resolve issues with their pc window software, Linux, and Mac.
